questions.question: Of course. Please provide the lecture transcript you would like me to use.
Once you paste the transcript, I will generate the 5 questions based on its content.
In the meantime, here is a **template example** using a hypothetical lecture about the causes of the Roman Empire's decline. You can see how the questions build in complexity.
### **Example based on a hypothetical lecture on the Fall of Rome:**
According to the lecture, list three economic problems that contributed to the decline of the Roman Empire.
In your own words, explain how the lecture connects the concept of "barbarian invasions" to the Empire's internal political instability.
